2  This petition coming on for admission this day, th e cou  following:
 ORDER
Shri Dheeraj Tiwari, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner Rakesh Shukla submits that he has filed a petition for fair investigation.

Shri Manas Mani Verma has produced a communication dated 20.07.2023 sent by the SHO, Police Station Bijuri, District Anuppur mentioning therein that after investigation charge-sheet No.122/23 was prepared on 02.06.2023 against the accused persons Satish Sharma s/o Late Shri T.P. Sharma and Rakesh Shukla s/o Shri Chitani Prasad Shukla both resident of Mines Colony, Bijuri but in another crime No.39/23 under Section 7(c), 13(1)
(a), 13(2) P.C. Act and Section 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B IPC since they are absconding,
therefore, charge-sheet could not be filed in the Court.

Since charge-sheet is ready and there is no prohibition from filing the same in absence of the accused persons as they are absconding,
therefore, Shri Manas Mani Verma submits that charge-sheet will be filed within three working days before the Court having competent jurisdiction.

In view of the aforesaid undertaking given by Shri Manas Mani Verma, as far as, petition filed by Shri Snjay Mahto is concerned, his grievous stands satiated and no further action is required.
Therefore, petition is disposed of accordingly.

As far as, Shri Dheeraj Tiwari, learned counsel for the petitioner in W.P. No.15886/2023 (Rakesh Shukla Vs. State of M.P. and Ors.) is concerned, since investigation is complete and charge-sheet is going to be filed within three days, he will have an opportunity to argue before the Court having competent jurisdiction on the aspect of framing of charges.

sentences.text:
At this Stage, no indulgence can be shown to give directions for any further investigation or fair investigation, that will be within the domain of the concerned Magistrate in terms of the provisions contained in Section 173(8) of Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this petition is too disposed of.
Shri Manas Mani Verma informs that there is criminal history of seven cases against the petitioner Rakesh Shukla and he is not cooperating with the I.O. and his absconding.

Shri Dheeraj Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel, submits that in fact W.P. No.15886/2023 is not maintainable inasmuch as earlier petitioner Shri Rakesh Shukla had filed M.Cr.C. No.38630/2022 under Section 482 for quashing of the FIR.

Now on the same grounds and seeking almost identical Sanjay Mahto vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82266546/
